name: Firecracker Ice Pops 18 x 50 mL
description:
One of the original Popsicle summer treats, Firecracker®, the red, white and blue frozen pops are classic. With only 45 calories per pop and delicious Cherry, White Lemon and Blue Raspberry flavours. Ideal for any occasion, serve this family favourite at a party or keep them in the freezer for an after-dinner frozen snack. Popsicle pops have been a treasured treat for over 100 years and remain a Canadian family favourite. The very first Popsicle® ice pop was created way back in 1905 by an 11-year-old named Frank Epperson. That's right, Popsicle was invented by a kid. After a long day of play, Frank went inside, but left his cup of soda with the stirring stick still in it out on the porch. The night got cold, and when Frank went outside the next morning, he found his drink frozen like an icicle. Frank called his invention the "Epsicle." It was a hit with the kids at school, and later with his kids, who called it "Pop's sicle." The name was catchy, and the treat was delicious, so Frank patented it in 1923 to share his Popsicle ice pops with the world. A lot has happened since 1905, when the first Popsicle ice pop was made. Popsicle Ice Pops now come in a rainbow of varieties.

Classic red, white and blue Popsicle ice pops that are a staple in the Popsicle product lineup and a perfect frozen treat
This popsicle has a fun firecracker shape with layers of Cherry, White Lemon with a Blue Raspberry
Popsicle Firecracker Ice Pops are a low-calorie frozen snack. Each ice pop contains only 45 calories
The perfect summer ice pop, enjoy anywhere, anytime

description: Make pasta night a superb hit with the wholesome nutty taste of Blue Menu Whole Grain Rotini. A good source of iron, this rotini is great for mixing with your favourite vodka sauces, alfredo sauces, tomato-based sauces, and so much more.

name: Zero Sugar Soda, Cream Soda
description: You’ll love that Zevia Cream Soda’s naturally sweetened, and has zero sugar and zero calories. But what you’ll really love is the way it makes the line between Soda and dessert very, very blurry — thanks to it’s deep aroma and luscious creamy, vanillary, buttery taste. So, is it a cream soda? Or is it a dessert? We suspect sweet tooths won’t get too hung up on this sweet conundrum.

name: Morning Crisp Bursting With Nuts Granola Cereal
description: Jordans Morning Crisp Bursting With Nuts Granola Cereal is a delightfully nutty and crunchy whole grain cereal packed with almonds, Brazil nuts, hazelnuts and pecans. Enjoy Morning Crisp as a breakfast cereal, afternoon snack or in a satisfying trail mix. This vegetarian, non-GMO cereal is made with real ingredients and no artificial colours, flavours or preservatives. The hearty oat clusters contain nourishing whole grains and are a source of fibre. With its great taste and crunchy texture, this granola cereal is easy to go nuts for. name: Spinach, Bunched
description: Spinach has dark green leaves that are either flat and smooth or curly and crinkled. Both have crisp, fragrant leaves and a slightly bitter flavour. Spinach can be very gritty and must be rinsed thoroughly. Use raw in salad, combine with feta for spanakopita, or sauté in olive oil and garlic for a simple side dish.

name: Cookies and Creme Cake
description: Savour the sweet things in life, like Cookies and Creme Cake. This cookie-flavoured cake is topped with creamy frosting, crushed cookie pieces, and chocolate drizzle.

name: Energy Drink Sugarfree™
description: Elevate your energy levels with Energy Drink Sugarfree ™ by Red Bull. Whether you're gearing up for a workout or needing a boost during a long work session, this drink offers the drive you need without the added sugar. Enjoy it chilled to refresh yourself on a hot day, or use it as an invigorating mixer to create exciting beverages.

name: Canola Oil
description: Saporito Foods Canola Oil is a premium quality oil that is ideal for deep frying, pan frying, baking, seasoning, salad dressings and wok cooking. Canola Oil has no trans fats, no cholesterol, and is low in saturated fats.  A healthy diet low in saturated and trans fats may reduce the risk of heart disease.  Canola Oil is also a source of Omega-3.

name: Spinach + Kale + Apple Cold Pressed Juice with Probiotics for Gut Health
description: Spinach, Kale, and Apple Cold-Pressed Juice contains probiotics that contribute to healthy gut flora. A juice blend with other ingredients, it's made without the use of artificial flavours or synthetic colours.

name: Original Snack Mix 250g
description: Talk about a dream team of delicious flavours! The classic combination of Doritos, Cheetos, SunChips, and Rold Gold®brands is the perfect mix for when you want ALL of these snacks at once. No wonder Munchies Snack Mix has been a snack staple across Canada for over 2 decades!The best part about Munchies Snack Mix? No two handfuls are the same. Every time you reach into that bag, you come out with a different — but always delicious — combination of snacks.For an extremely cheesy one-two punch, we start off with the bold flavour of Doritos Nacho Cheese flavoured tortilla chips, accompanied by the crunch of Cheetos Crunchy cheese flavoured snacks.Next up, we mix in some delicious SunChips Harvest Cheddar flavour multigrain snacks — that have cheesy flavour in every chip.Finally, come the pretzels! People have been falling in love with the one-of-a-kind flavour and crispy, crunchy texture of Rold Gold pretzels for decades, and they pair perfectly alongside this tasty trio of chips.

name: High Protein Triple Berry Instant Oatmeal
description:
Quaker High Protein Triple Berry Instant Oatmeal is delicious, nutritious, and ready to eat in just 1 – 2 minutes. Quaker High Protein Triple Berry Instant Oatmeal was designed to give you that extra boost of protein in the morning without sacrificing any of the great taste you've come to expect from Quaker. This tasty instant oatmeal is made with the goodness of whole grain Canadian oats and no artificial flavours or colours, so it’s a quick oatmeal you can feel good about serving the whole family. For even more great taste, add milk, fruit, or your favourite toppings to this convenient instant oatmeal.
Berry Good — Our Triple Berry instant oatmeal combines strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries for a burst of fruity taste you know and love.
Packed With Protein — With 6 grams of protein in every 38 g packet, this high protein instant oatmeal helps to fill you up and give you the energy you need to take on your active day.
Quick And Easy — Convenient Quaker High Protein Triple Berry Instant Oatmeal gets your day off to a nutritious and delicious start in less than 2 minutes.
Quality Ingredients — Quaker High Protein Triple Berry Instant Oatmeal is proudly made with 100 % whole grain Canadian oats and no artificial flavours or colours, so you can feel good about every last bite!
A Perfect Pairing — Quaker hot cereal pairs well with all your favourite morning options. Try adding some fresh fruit, milk or your favourite toppings to create a custom breakfast option you’ll love.

name: Chocolatey Chip Light Ice Cream
description:
Discover the delightful taste of Breyers Creamery Style Chocolatey Chip Light Ice Cream, where rich and creamy vanilla meets decadent chocolatey chips. Crafted with real ingredients and all-natural colours and flavours, this light ice cream is the perfect sweet snack or an exquisite complement to your favourite dessert. Enjoy it on its own or paired with a delicious treat for a delightful experience for your taste buds. Whether it's a cozy family night or a special celebration, Breyers Creamery Style Chocolatey Chip Light Ice Cream is a treat everyone will love. Enjoy the rich and creamy vanilla mixed with chocolatey chips, knowing that it's made with care and quality in every scoop.
Breyers has been a staple in Canadian freezers for over 30 years. When you buy Breyers, you know you are buying a dessert that uses the highest quality ingredients in all our ice cream and frozen dessert recipes.
In 1866, William Breyer took his passion for creating high-quality desserts and set out to start his very own brand of ice cream – Breyers. Thanks to his commitment to delivering delicious ice cream using only local and simple ingredients, the Breyers brand was soon loved by customers far and wide! Today, Breyers has committed to using flavours and colours from only natural sources, sustainably farmed fruit and vanilla, and Canadian milk and cream. Breyers is proudly made in Simcoe, Ontario, using 100% Canadian Dairy.
• Chip out with rich and creamy vanilla Breyers light ice cream mixed with rich chocolatey chips in Breyers Chocolatey Chip frozen treat• Made with real ingredients and all natural colours and flavour, it's the perfect sweet snack or complement to your favourite dessert• All Breyers ice cream and frozen desserts are proudly made in Canada, at our creamery in Simcoe, Ontario• Breyers ice cream is made in accordance with our Breyers Pledge, starting with only high-quality ingredients.• Made in Canada with 100% Canadian milk and fresh cream from Canadian farms.• This delicious Breyers frozen dessert is kosher certified.

name: Notre-Dame Brie Cheese
description: A honeycombed soft cheese, Brie Notre-Dame charms us with each bite. Its flavour of cream is enhanced by a delicious hint of mushroom.

name: Smooth Caramel for NESPRESSO VERTUO, Coffee
description: Add a splash of Café-inspired flavour to your everyday cup with STARBUCKS Smooth Caramel for NESPRESSO VERTUO coffee capsules. Bask in the delectable caramel sweetness of this flavoured blonde roast with notes of buttery caramel and vanilla. Each cup of STARBUCKS Smooth Caramel flavoured coffee is balanced, and has no artificial colours or flavours.  With every delicious sip, enjoy the authentic café taste of STARBUCKS coffee at home like never before. All STARBUCKS coffees are ethically sourced in accordance to Coffee and Farmer Equity (C.A.F.E.) Practices, a sourcing standard STARBUCKS developed in collaboration with Conservation International. These flavoured Arabica coffee capsules have been developed to work with NESPRESSO VERTUO machines and are easily recyclable through the NESPRESSO recycling program. Enhance your enjoyment of STARBUCKS Smooth Caramel coffee by adding STARBUCKS Caramel Macchiato coffee enhancer. Explore the whole STARBUCKS by NESPRESSO for VERTUO range of coffee and espresso capsules. Authentically delicious perfection is just a cup away!

name: Light Sour Cream
description: Tangy. Tasty. Classic. Dairyland sour cream has been an essential part of the family that always brings out the best in food. It comes in all kinds of tasty options to add that sour twist to your favourite dishes.Try it with soups, sauces, baked potatoes, or enjoy it as the essential dip for any chip. Choose from fat-free, light, and regular, available in a variety of sizes, so you can make any sour cream recipe just the way you like.

name: Soft Unripened Goat's Milk Cheese
description: This goat’s milk cheese brings tangy flavour to pizza, everyday toast, pasta and cream sauces. Enjoy its luxuriously creamy texture knowing it has 35% less fat than regular PC Goat’s Milk Cheese. The fat is reduced, but not the taste. Now available in a larger 300 g size for families and goat cheese devotees.

name: Gourmet Medium Roast Fine Grind Coffee
description: So great we call it gourmet. There’s nothing basic about this medium roast coffee. It delivers dreamy, drink-me-now chocolate colour and rich flavour notes of dried fruit, brown sugar, and subtle cocoa. Our PC® coffee experts selected these 100% Arabica beans from Indonesia, Sumatra, Kenya, Ethiopia and beyond. They are then roasted and blended in Canada for a fresh-tasting, balanced, medium-bodied mug. You know what’s also fresh? Our award-winning, recyclable packaging* that locks in this ground coffee’s flavour and aroma, so it’s always ready when you are. Brew tip: This grind size is best for cone-filter coffee, pour-overs, and espresso—no grinder needed!*Our recyclable packaging is made with a minimum 80% paper content—freshness seal is not recyclable.

name: Beef Stew Seasoning Mix
description: This is an all-star meal of savoury meat, vegetables and hearty broth. Club House® Beef Stew Seasoning Mix takes the guesswork out of blending spices for a perfectly flavoured beef stew. Our beef stew mix makes preparing this home-style dinner easier and tastier than ever. A blend of Club House® herbs & spices, including paprika, black pepper and thyme, this mix adds the perfect balance of flavour to beef, potatoes and vegetables. To prepare, brown the beef cubes, stir in seasoning mix, water and fresh vegetables, and simmer until the meat is tender. You can feel good about dishing out this comfort food favourite to your family.

name: Two-Bite Brownies
description: Enjoy a sweet treat after your meal with Two-Bite Brownies. Soft and chewy, they melt in your mouth in just 2 bites. These brownies are great for lunch boxes and late-night snacking. Peanut free.
